# CGRX v0.1.0-alpha.19

- Opt-in Fast Anything profiling for selected Node/Python workloads. Source inputs come from the exact Git commit. Explicit input paths keep snapshots small, graph eviction does not cancel a scan, and temporary failures retry after a cooldown.
- Profiling reports review-only hotspot candidates through MCP; it never applies changes to a project.
- Bounded quality lock waits and clearer memory-store diagnostics keep graph queries useful when background work or memory is unavailable.
- The multi-repo MCP server honors the selected tool preset. Its default remains full.
- The visualizer loads 3D code on demand; CI checks both generated bundles. Hermes now uses the shared installer.

Fast Anything is optional. Configure a small trusted benchmark with [explicit inputs](../../docs/quality-continuous.md#optional-automatic-performance-suggestions); profilers run in a temporary copy, not an OS or network sandbox.
